.( ⁧أَفَادَ المُتَحَدِّثُ بِأَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَتَلَقَّوْا أَيَّ طَلَبٍ رَسْمِيٍّ⁩ ) ⁧نَفَى المُتَحَدِّثُ أَنْ يَكُونُوا قَدْ تَلَقَّوْا أَيَّ طَلَبٍ رَسْمِيٍّ⁩

.( ⁧تَسَاءَلَ النَّائِبُ كَيْفَ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ يَحْدُثَ مِثْلُ هٰذَا التَّأْخِيرِ⁩ ) « ⁧كَيْفَ يُعْقَلُ تَأْخِيرٌ كَهٰذَا؟⁩ » ⁧تَسَاءَلَ النَّائِبُ:⁩
.( ⁧إِلَى تَرْشِيدِ اسْتِهْلَاكِ المَاءِ⁩ … ⁧دَعَا⁩ ) ⁧طَلَبَ رَئِيسُ البَلَدِيَّةِ مِنَ المُوَاطِنِينَ أَنْ يُوَفِّرُوا المَاءَ⁩

Exercise 10. 1. The Prime Minister admitted that the government did not manage to keep prices under control, but stressed that there would be an improvement in the following months. 2. In its statement, the company claimed that the water used in the plant was treated before being discharged into the river, which the inhabitants of the area doubt. 3. The newspaper reported, citing a source close to the presidency, that the president would (hear) hold an important speech next week. 4. The Member wondered whether the Ministry had conducted a study before taking the decision and asked for the results to be published. 5. According to a local press agency, negotiations between the union and management would have reached a dead end. Delicate points: in 1 ⁧أقر⁩ • allowed and the concordance (s) would have been there; in 2 ⁧زعمت⁩ → conjunctive or conditional, and ⁧يشكك فيه⁩ They doubt this; in 3 the anonymous but located source; in 4 ⁧عما إذا⁩ and ⁧مطالبا⁩ ( ḥāl); in 5 the second hand source.
